summary: Confirmed the inherited reservable/booking site/2-night weekend minimum/14-night max for this park and $39.99 (electric, weeknight and weekend). Added 50-amp electric with water and no sewer, 36 sites (10 RV, 26 tent-only), dump, wifi, season spring-fall. Not stated: showers/toilets, max rig length in feet, holiday minimum.
flags: Phone missing: the park page gives 304-265-6144.

Conflict between the park's own pages: the lodging page lists '10 full hookups'; the camping page says the ten have '50-amp electric and water hookups' and 'Full hookup sites are not available'. Recorded the camping page (sewer false).
Only 10 sites take an RV; the booking site tags them with the '20' to 30' RV' class only (no longer class), so space for a 23-ft rig is fine but larger rigs are not listed.
